contact.description: The supplier, by its name on the Contacts sheet: the entry's key.

country.description: Where it is resident for tax; ignored in a change.

nature.description: The nature of payment its bills record for the tax agent's withholding decision (FR-AP-19); empty until the Accountant chooses, which stops the sign-off.

outcome.description: The tax agent's decision its bills post with: not_applicable, or withhold at the rate they advised (treaty: a reduced treaty rate); empty until entered, which stops the sign-off.

rate_percent.description: The rate withheld, a percentage: only when tax is withheld.

row.description: Its row on the Contacts sheet; ignored in a change.
